verdict.rationale: Shopify documents several official MCP servers that AI agents and assistants connect to directly: Storefront MCP, Cart MCP, Checkout MCP and Order MCP. A probe also confirms an official MCP server documented at shopify.dev/docs/agents. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agent connection, detailed connection/auth setup steps in the evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Connect any AI assistant to real-time commerce data from Shopify stores with Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers.
Use the Order MCP server to fetch the current state of an order placed through your agent, including line items, fulfillment events, and post-purchase adjustments.
enables AI agents to build and iterate on a cart before the buyer commits to purchase
enables AI agents to create and manage checkout sessions, convert carts into checkouts, and refer buyers to the merchant storefront to complete purchases
official MCP server documented at https://shopify.dev/docs/agents
